content.title: Murano Global Investments (MRNO): Loss Acceleration Undermines Turnaround Hopes, Challenges Bullish Narratives
content.summary: Murano Global Investments (MRNO) remains in the red, with losses accelerating over the past five years at a steep 99.7% annual pace. The company’s price-to-sales ratio comes in at 3.3x, placing it above the US Real Estate industry average of 3.1x and highlighting an expensive valuation for a business that still lacks profitability or visible earnings growth.
